description: This file defines a testing proxy for Ginkgo, a BDD testing framework for Go. It includes type definitions, interface implementations, and functions to support test execution, environment management, and reporting.

classes.name: ginkgoTestingTProxy
classes.description: A proxy implementing testing interface for Ginkgo, supporting test lifecycle, logging, environment, and reporting functionalities.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Registers a cleanup function to be called after test.

methods.name: Setenv
methods.description: Sets an environment variable with cleanup.

methods.name: Chdir
methods.description: Changes current directory with cleanup.

methods.name: Context
methods.description: Creates a cancellable context for the test.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Logs an error message.

methods.name: Errorf
methods.description: Logs a formatted error message.

methods.name: Fail
methods.description: Marks the test as failed.

methods.name: FailNow
methods.description: Marks the test as failed and stops execution.

methods.name: Failed
methods.description: Returns whether the test has failed.

methods.name: Fatal
methods.description: Logs a fatal error and stops test.

methods.name: Fatalf
methods.description: Logs a formatted fatal error and stops test.

methods.name: Helper
methods.description: Marks the calling function as a test helper.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Logs a message.

methods.name: Logf
methods.description: Logs a formatted message.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the full text name of the current test.

methods.name: Parallel
methods.description: No-op method for parallel execution support.

methods.name: Skip
methods.description: Skips the current test with a message.

methods.name: SkipNow
methods.description: Skips the current test immediately.

methods.name: Skipf
methods.description: Skips the current test with a formatted message.

methods.name: Skipped
methods.description: Returns whether the test was skipped.

methods.name: TempDir
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory for the test.

methods.name: AddReportEntryVisibilityAlways
methods.description: Adds a report entry with always visible visibility.

methods.name: AddReportEntryVisibilityFailureOrVerbose
methods.description: Adds a report entry visible on failure or verbose.

methods.name: AddReportEntryVisibilityNever
methods.description: Adds a report entry never visible.

methods.name: Print
methods.description: Prints to the test output.

methods.name: Printf
methods.description: Prints a formatted message to the test output.

methods.name: Println
methods.description: Prints a line to the test output.

methods.name: F
methods.description: Formats a string with no color.

methods.name: Fi
methods.description: Formats a string with indentation.

methods.name: Fiw
methods.description: Formats a string with indentation and max width.

methods.name: RenderTimeline
methods.description: Renders a test timeline report.

methods.name: GinkgoRecover
methods.description: Recovers from a panic in a test.

methods.name: DeferCleanup
methods.description: Defers a cleanup function.

methods.name: RandomSeed
methods.description: Returns the random seed used.

methods.name: ParallelProcess
methods.description: Returns the parallel process index.

methods.name: ParallelTotal
methods.description: Returns total number of parallel processes.

methods.name: AttachProgressReporter
methods.description: Attaches a progress reporter function.

methods.name: Output
methods.description: Returns the output writer.

methods.name: Attr
methods.description: Adds an attribute key-value pair to report.
